name: pmg-cut-scope-with-moscow
description: Cuts scope to a fixed date with MoSCoW, producing a Must / Should / Could / Won't list, a Must budget check and a Won't-this-time list. Use for "run pmg-cut-scope-with-moscow", "MoSCoW prioritisation", "the date is fixed and scope has to give", "must have should have could have", "cut scope for the release", "what can we drop before launch", "everything is a must", "we will miss the date", part of The Complete Claude Guide for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
